methodology: Automated real-time session on the layered street with new enemy encounters (2.5D view). Test hook is read-only: no teleports, no clock changes, no changes to health, enemies, inventory or RNG. All actions use visible buttons and real keyboard/mouse, including E opening and native inventory drag for crates and corpses. This is not a human fun/balance evaluation.

timing.method: Wall intervals attributed to the previous observed UI state (including its UI actions); simulation sums nonnegative published run-clock deltas. Neither is a GPU/active-fun measurement.

observationPolicy: First complete a native transfer at a dynamically reachable container whose route passes the original 220px/LOS danger boundary. Then approach a visible new enemy and observe its actual windup. No game-state mutations.
